name: Route table
summary: Route table with user-defined routes, associated with a subnet to force traffic through a firewall, NVA or gateway.
useWhen: You need to force traffic from a subnet through Azure Firewall or a network virtual appliance
You need a default route (0.0.0.0/0) that overrides the implicit internet route
avoidWhen: Default system routing is sufficient (most subnets need no route table at all)
